episodes.title: Droids in Distress
episodes.summary: The Ghost crew steal a shipment of disruptor weapons to sell to crime lord Cikatro Vizago, accidentally bringing the Imperially serviced droids C-3PO and R2-D2with them in the process. Zeb objects to the mission since the same weapons were used to nearly wipe out his species, the Lasats. Agent Kallus intercepts C-3PO's distress call and follows the Ghost to Lothal. In the ensuing duel between Zeb and Kallus, Ezra saves Zeb by using the Force to push Kallus away, allowing the crew to escape after setting the weapons to self-destruct as a diversion. Kanan returns the two droids to their rightful owner Bail Organa, who surveys R2-D2's recordings of the rebels' actions.

episodes.title: Fighter Flight
episodes.summary: While on a simple errand, Ezra and Zeb steal an Imperial vehicle.

episodes.title: Rise of the Old Masters
episodes.summary: The Rebels undergo a daring rescue mission, only to find themselves facing a powerful foe.

episodes.title: Breaking Ranks
episodes.summary: Ezra goes undercover inside the Empire to retrieve vital information for an operation.

episodes.title: Out of Darkness
episodes.summary: While on a supply run, Hera and Sabine find themselves stranded but not alone in a seemingly abandoned locale.

episodes.title: Empire Day
episodes.summary: Refugee of the Empire seeks the Rebels' help to get off the planet with important information.

episodes.title: Gathering Forces
episodes.summary: To protect the Imperial deserter, Kanan and Ezra attempt to distract the pursuing Imperial forces, resulting in a confrontation.

episodes.title: Path of the Jedi
episodes.summary: Ezra must face a great challenge as part of his growth as a member of the team.

episodes.title: Idiot's Array
episodes.summary: The wrong gamble with a new acquaintance forces the crew into transporting some unusual cargo.

episodes.title: Vision of Hope
episodes.summary: While attending a gathering for those who would oppose the Empire, the crew finds out something unexpected.

episodes.title: Call to Action
episodes.summary: As public awareness increases around the Rebels activity, they target an important Imperial network.

episodes.title: Rebel Resolve
episodes.summary: The Rebels attack an Imperial courier hoping to glean information that will help them lead a dangerous rescue attempt.

episodes.title: Fire Across the Galaxy
episodes.summary: In this final episode of a thrilling two-part season finale, a daring rescue by the Rebels causes an increase in Imperial activity, forcing the crew to call for help.

episodes.title: The Siege of Lothal
episodes.summary: On orders to hunt down the Rebels, and especially the Jedi among them, Darth Vader begins an oppressive campaign against Lothal's populace in order to find the group. The Ghost crew starts working with the wider Rebel cells, but are divided between joining the larger network and waging open war on the Empire, or staying out of a large-scale fight. The situation is even more complicated when Minister Maketh Tua, fearing punishment for failing to neutralize the Lothal rebels, tries to defect to them in order to escape Vader, offering to reveal the truth behind why the Emperor wants the planet. Vader, however, uses this to his advantage and orchestrates Tua's murder by shuttle explosion, framing the rebels for the act and turning Lothal's population against them. The Ghost crew tries to flee but are cornered by Vader, who injures Kanan and Sabine and nearly kills Ezra before they finally escape. After being smuggled off-world by Lando Calrissian to escape the Empire, the demoralized crew meet up with Ahsoka's rebel cell, but Vader pursues them and proceeds to wipe out most of the rebel ships, discovering Ahsoka in the process. Ahsoka is horrified to learn that Vader is actually her old Jedi master, Anakin Skywalker. She joins the Ghost crew as they vow to join the wider fight against the Empire. Darth Vader later reports Ahsoka's existence to Emperor Palpatine, who issues Darth Vader new orders to dispatch another one of their Inquisitors to capture the crew of the Ghost.

episodes.title: The Lost Commanders
episodes.summary: Having barely escaped total destruction of the rebel cell Phoenix Squadron by Darth Vader, Ahsoka Tano sends the Ghost Crew to locate a former military commander somewhere in the Seetos system who has the knowledge of useful hideouts in the Outer Rim. The crew discover the commander to be former clone trooper Captain Rex, accompanied by Commander Wolffe and clone commando Gregor. Kanan is immediately hostile due to the clones' role in Order 66 but Ezra negotiates with Rex for information relating to potential bases. In return Gregor enlists them for a hunt by using Zeb as bait. With the hunt successful, Rex holds up his end of the deal but Sabine discovers that Wolffe betrayed the Ghost crew's location to the Empire. A skirmish with an Imperial probe damages the Phantom shuttle, the crew is temporarily stranded with the clones waiting for an Imperial assault.

episodes.title: Relics of the Old Republic
episodes.summary: Ezra and the crew begin to develop friendships with Captain Rex and his colleagues.

episodes.title: Always Two There Are
episodes.summary: Ezra, Sabine, Zeb and Chopper venture to an abandoned medical station to salvage supplies but are interrupted by the arrival of Inquisitors.

episodes.title: Brothers of the Broken Horn
episodes.summary: Trying to escape the pressure of being a Jedi, Ezra responds to a distress call with Chopper; the ship in distress belongs to Hondo Ohnaka, who has an offer for Ezra.

episodes.title: Wings of the Master
episodes.summary: Hera goes on a dangerous mission to acquire a new ship, the B-Wing, to help break a blockade and turn the tide in a crucial battle against the Empire.

episodes.title: Blood Sisters
episodes.summary: On a mission to escort a courier with secret information vital to the rebel cause to a rendezvous point, Sabine must face off against her old friend and partner.

episodes.title: Stealth Strike
episodes.summary: A new Imperial ship captures Ezra, Commander Sato, and his crew, forcing Kanan and the clone to go undercover as stormtroopers to free the rebels.

episodes.title: The Future of the Force
episodes.summary: The rebels learn that the Inquisitors are seeking out Force-sensitive children, and they work together to protect the young ones from the Inquisitors' pursuit.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.summary: As the Empire attacks the rebel fleet on Garel, Kanan and Ezra return to Lothal and find a former prisoner with knowledge about Ezra's parents.

episodes.title: A Princess on Lothal
episodes.summary: An aide to Bail Organa is sent to Lothal with ships for the rebel fleet, but an Imperial lockdown forces the rebels to come up with a new plan to steal the vehicles.

episodes.title: The Protector of Concord Dawn
episodes.summary: In need of new hyperspace routes due to Imperial pressure, the rebels find a shortcut but must first gain permission to use it.

episodes.title: Legends of the Lasat
episodes.summary: When the crew of the Ghost agrees to help two refugees who are revealed to be surviving Lasat, Zeb must come to terms with his past to help his people reach their new home.

episodes.title: The Call
episodes.summary: While on a mission to obtain fuel for the rebel fleet, the crew works to protect space creatures from the Techno Union asteroid mining operation that threatens the creatures' lives.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: The rebels contact freedom fighter Cham Syndulla, who needs help to fight off the Imperial bombing attack on his planet. While coordinating a plan to overtake and steal the carrier that houses these Imperial bombers, the rebels discover that Cham may have a plan of his own.

episodes.title: The Honorable Ones
episodes.summary: Zeb and Agent Kallus find themselves stranded on an ice planet after a failed Imperial ambush of the rebels. With Kallus injured from the escape pod crash, he and Zeb must work together to survive the harsh conditions.

episodes.title: Shroud of Darkness
episodes.summary: Kanan, Ezra and Ahsoka return to the Jedi Temple on Lothal, seeking answers from Yoda about the Inquisitors' ability to continually track the rebels.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Droid
episodes.summary: When Chopper gets left behind at an Imperial outpost, he forms an unlikely friendship with an Imperial droid, and discovers a base location for the rebels.

episodes.title: The Mystery of Chopper Base
episodes.summary: Kanan, Ezra and Ahsoka prepare to depart to unravel Vader's secret, while the rebels find a way to fend off the predatory creatures that occupy the planet.

episodes.title: Twilight of the Apprentice
episodes.summary: Kanan, Ezra and Ahsoka gain information about the Sith and battle the Inquisitors with the help of a new ally, but when Vader arrives they quickly find themselves overmatched.

episodes.title: Steps Into Shadow
episodes.summary: A more powerful Ezra leads Sabine, Zeb, Chopper and Hera on a mission to rescue Hondo Ohnaka; the mission goes awry. Kanan finds an ancient force creature know as "The Bendu" and returns to help the Ghost crew. Grand Admiral Thrawn emerges as a new threat.

episodes.title: The Holocrons of Fate
episodes.summary: Maul takes the crew of the Ghost hostage and Ezra and Kanan must recover an ancient Sith artifact to save them.

episodes.title: The Antilles Extraction
episodes.summary: Sabine goes undercover as a cadet in the Empire's elite flight academy to help break out several young pilots wanting to defect to the rebellion.

episodes.title: Hera's Heroes
episodes.summary: Hera's rebel supply mission to Ryloth becomes personal when she and the Ghost crew brave overwhelming Imperial forces to recover a memento from her ancestral home.

episodes.title: The Last Battle
episodes.summary: On a salvage mission led by Captain Rex, the Ghost crew is captured by a unit of old battle droids determined to fight one last battle to end the clone wars.

episodes.title: Imperial Supercommandos
episodes.summary: Having lost contact with the Protectors of Concord Dawn, Sabine, Ezra, and Fenn Rau investigate and find the base occupied by Imperial Mandalorians.

episodes.title: Iron Squadron
episodes.summary: Ezra and Sabine try to tame a rogue pilot and his crew who recklessly risk their lives in a fight to defend their home world from Imperial occupation.

episodes.title: The Wynkahthu Job
episodes.summary: The rebels team with a pair of unscrupulous pirates to salvage a freighter full of weapons for the rebellion, but the mission ends up being far more dangerous than anticipated.

episodes.title: An Inside Man
episodes.summary: Seeking information on a new Imperial weapon, Ezra and Kanan infiltrate the Imperial factory on Lothal, but must trust an unlikely ally to escape a lockdown.

episodes.title: Visions and Voices
episodes.summary: Haunted by visions of Maul, Ezra must journey across the galaxy to engage in a strange ritual to sever his connection with Maul.

episodes.title: Ghosts of Geonosis: Part 1
episodes.summary: The crew returns to Geonosis in search of a missing rebel team sent to investigate suspicious activity there and are surprised by what they find.

episodes.title: Ghosts of Geonosis: Part 2
episodes.summary: After finding a missing rebel team member, the Ghost crew discovers another surprise on Geonosis and work to conceal it from Imperial Forces.

episodes.title: Warhead
episodes.summary: Zeb and Chopper bring a damaged droid found in the Atollon wilderness back to base, only to discover that the droid is a new Imperial probe programmed to spy on and destroy rebels.

episodes.title: Trials of the Darksaber
episodes.summary: To help recruit her people to join the rebels, Sabine reluctantly agrees to learn to wield an ancient Mandalorian weapon but finds the challenge more difficult than expected.

episodes.title: Legacy of Mandalore
episodes.summary: Hoping to get her family to help the rebels, Sabine returns home with Kanan and Ezra, and finds herself embroiled in her family's power struggle for Mandalore.

episodes.title: Through Imperial Eyes
episodes.summary: Fearing that the Empire will soon discover the identity of a rebel spy, the Rebels launch a plan to rescue him before his capture.

episodes.title: Secret Cargo
episodes.summary: When a routine refueling mission goes wrong, the Ghost crew find themselves transporting an important rebel leader across the galaxy, pursued by Imperial warships.

episodes.title: Double Agent Droid
episodes.summary: Chopper and AP-5 team up to infiltrate an Imperial station to steal needed codes, but an Imperial specialist turns the droids against the crew to cause chaos.

episodes.title: Twin Suns
episodes.summary: Reacting to a vision of Maul, Ezra defies Hera and Kanan to travel to a remote planet in hopes of stopping the former Sith lord from carrying out his plans.

episodes.title: Zero Hour: Part 1
episodes.summary: In the final preparations for Phoenix Squadron's attack on Lothal, Grand Admiral Thrawn discovers their location and disrupts their plans.

episodes.title: Zero Hour: Part 2
episodes.summary: Trapped on Atollon with the rebel base under siege, Hera and Kanan fight to keep the squadron alive, as Ezra attempts to rally help from an unexpected source.

episodes.title: Heroes of Mandalore: Part 1
episodes.summary: Sabine leads Ezra, Kanan, and an army of her fellow Mandalorians back to her homeworld to rescue her father from the clutches of the Empire.

episodes.title: Heroes of Mandalore: Part 2
episodes.summary: When Sabine discovers the Empire resurrected a devastating weapon she created and plans to use it against her people, she must decide whether to destroy it or use it herself.

episodes.title: In the Name of the Rebellion: Part 1
episodes.summary: As members of the Rebel Alliance, Ezra and the Ghost crew must accept a mission to spy on an Imperial outpost they would rather destroy.

episodes.title: In the Name of the Rebellion: Part 2
episodes.summary: After being separated from Hera and Kana, Ezra and Sabine join the desperate quest of Saw Gerrera to hunt down the Empire's elusive secret super weapon.

episodes.title: The Occupation
episodes.summary: Ezra and the Ghost crew are called back to Lothal when a new Imperial threat rises.

episodes.title: Flight of the Defender
episodes.summary: Ezra and Sabine steal an Imperial prototype TIE fighter but must rely on some unexpected help to escape from Thrawn.

episodes.title: Kindred
episodes.summary: Tracked back to their hidden base by a mysterious Imperial agent, the rebels must trust some seemingly dangerous native creatures, who are far more than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Crawler Commandeers
episodes.summary: Desperate to contact rebel command, the Ghost crew pirates a mining vehicle with long-range communications gear, but the Empire arrives to spoil their plans.

episodes.title: Rebel Assault
episodes.summary: Hera leads a courageous attack against the forces of Grand Admiral Thrawn, but when things go awry, her battle to win must become a daring escape if she is to survive.

episodes.title: Jedi Night
episodes.summary: The Ghost Crew infiltrates the Imperial headquarters on Lothal to save one of their own.

episodes.title: DUME
episodes.summary: Reeling from a devastating loss, the Ghost crew rallies together to find a new purpose and resolve.

episodes.title: Wolves and a Door
episodes.summary: Ezra and the Ghost crew discover the Empire's plans for the Jedi Temple on Lothal.

episodes.title: A World Between Worlds
episodes.summary: While the other rebels engage the Imperial forces outside the Jedi temple, Ezra gains access inside and experiences a revelation.

episodes.title: A Fool's Hope
episodes.summary: Ezra calls in every favor he can to rally together a ragtag group for a seemingly impossible fight against Governor Pryce and her Imperial forces.

episodes.title: Family Reunion – and Farewell
episodes.summary: Ezra's team takes drastic action to free Lothal, entering Imperial HQ, and Thrawn returns to stop them; Ezra must surrender and confront a greater evil.
